svg.title: S2 chatbot latency
svg.desc: Local response-time distributions. (a) Empirical cumulative distribution of 168 direct endpoint measurements, bypassing HTTP and routing. (b) Complete observations from 24 presentation JSON, 54 conversation JSON and 54 conversation SSE requests. (c) JSON and SSE timings matched by scenario and turn for 54 pairs; the dashed identity line indicates equal completion time, and overlapping points are retained without jitter. All observations, including extremes, are retained. Timings are from one sequential local run with no warm-up exclusion; they do not estimate production capacity or demonstrate a significant transport effect.
